metadata.title: What a Dark-Energy-Tied Galaxy Law Demands of Its Cold Sector: No-Go Theorems, a Covariant Parent, and the Labelled-Domain Construction (Working Note)
metadata.description:
Working note, version 1.0 (2026-10-21). AI-assisted research programme; not peer reviewed. kappa = 1/2 is fitted; the theory is not closed.

Structural lanes (criteria frozen before computing, mutation controls, post-hoc amendments disclosed, both a0 footings reported and never pooled) asking what any consistent theory of the collisionless 'cold energy' medium of a gravity framework must look like. The framework's galactic law is g_N = g^2/(g + a0), a0 = (1/2) c sqrt(G rho_DE); its extra gravitating mass is the cold energy, not a particle.

(1) A covariant parent: a fluid effective theory of comoving labels contains the record's static field equation under five stated conditions (CONDITIONAL). It reproduces the law to 2.2e-16 and has an isotropic dust background, a derived field-aligned stress, linear well-posedness and slip <= 1.54e-5. The medium's identity div P = rho - rhobar holds exactly through shell crossing, so the record's postulate that freed cold energy stays free cannot be derived from it. (2) No-go results: if the medium's excess is the law's phantom, the deep law forces the tether to cancel the medium's own gravity (no linear self-gravity, no gravity between tethered components). No ghost-free local Lagrangian switches the tether off in the linear universe without a vacuum offset 15-25 times the slip bound. A local second-order field that supplies the deep law must carry an external-field effect. Every tether without membership labels makes a satellite's medium hover while its stars fall. (3) No causal non-local parent has the record's cosmological engine as its exact limit: the engine's source relocation cannot conserve momentum, its resolution cut switches the law off for 128 of 175 SPARC galaxies, and its phantom is a global QUMOND field with an external-field effect. (4) Energy: the record's settling does not conserve energy, and no energy-conserving repair that keeps the released energy inside matter brings an infalling halo onto the law. (5) The labelled-domain construction removes the satellite hover and the linear-growth flag, but closes energy only through a non-dynamical label energy (NOT CONSISTENT AS SPECIFIED under its frozen rule; CONDITIONAL only under a post-hoc amendment), and it overshoots the eRASS1 cluster outer shear (Z = -9.3 canonical, -11.9 alternative). No complete parent survives. The two-footing shear pass of the companion notes remains a computational result of an engine whose physical parent is not established. (6) Data: faint gas-rich rotators do not reach the dwarfs' accelerations (not diagnostic); Coma ultra-diffuse galaxies sit above the derived ceiling, but not at 3 sigma once systematics are included; clusters modelled as untethered cold energy match the shear stack at the primary corner only, a fragile match.

Not derived: kappa = 1/2, the cold-to-baryon supply ratio, the retained fraction, the stiffness length. Companion notes: PAPER55 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23482936) and PAPER56. AI assistance: Anthropic's Claude (analysis lanes, review, drafting).
